purpose: Full-content review of 15 previously unreviewed cross-window candidates ranked 550-564. Both original source records, full stems, four options, answer keys and explanations were checked; similarity was used only for screening.

confirmed_duplicates.subject: Physics
confirmed_duplicates.concept: Distance corresponding to half a wavelength
confirmed_duplicates.reason: Adjacent nodes in a stationary wave are separated by half a wavelength; a crest and its adjacent trough are also separated by half a wavelength. Both ask for the same λ/2 relationship.

confirmed_duplicates.subject: Economics
confirmed_duplicates.concept: Law of supply: higher price leads to higher quantity supplied
confirmed_duplicates.reason: Both ask for the direct relationship between price and quantity supplied, other things equal. The stems and explanations are paraphrases of the same law of supply.

confirmed_duplicates.subject: Use of English
confirmed_duplicates.concept: Singular possessive apostrophe for one girl's ownership
confirmed_duplicates.reason: Both ask for the correct apostrophe form showing that one girl owns an item. The correct construction is girl's in both; the wording and options are minor variations of the same grammar item.
